SPEED — settles in one block

Settle invoices in one block

Invoices arrive from forty suppliers every week — most of them late, some of them twice. The finance team matches each one by hand — a spreadsheet, a bank export and a lot of patience. Our engine reads the ledger, the bank feed and the invoice inbox — then it proposes a match for every line. When a payment does not clear, the engine flags it — with the rule that failed and the amount at stake. Suppliers see their status in real time — no more emails asking where the money is. Settlement drops from three days to one block — and every payment links to its receipt.

The pilot ran with two finance teams for six weeks. They matched four thousand invoices, flagged ninety payments that did not clear and settled every supplier on the day the invoice was approved. Each figure on this page links to the ledger entry it comes from, and the simulated ones carry a label.
